# Recipes are data, not code: YAML subgraph definitions installed beside the block libraries so an installed loader can
# be pointed at them. Each recipe also ships a GENERATED typed C++ header (include/gnuradio-4.0/recipes/) — committed,
# regenerated by gr4-recipe-gen, and diffed by qa_Recipes so the YAML stays the single source of truth.
install(
  FILES index.yaml
        AfskDemod.yaml
        BpskDemod.yaml
        CcsdsConcatenatedFrames.yaml
        CcsdsRsFrames.yaml
        BpskFrontEnd.yaml
        DbpskDemod.yaml
        FskDemod.yaml
        FskDemodAudio.yaml
        FskDemodDcBlock.yaml
        HdlcDeframe.yaml
        KissFileWrite.yaml
        KissFileRead.yaml
        KissServe.yaml
        KissStreamDecode.yaml
        NbfmDemod.yaml
        OfdmDemodulator.yaml
        OfdmModulator.yaml
        SampleClockOffset.yaml
        WbfmMonoDemod.yaml
  DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/gnuradio-4.0/recipes")
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/gnuradio-4.0/recipes")
  install(DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/gnuradio-4.0/recipes"
          DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/gnuradio-4.0")
endif()

# the generator: reads the catalog, writes the typed headers; run by hand (or by name via ninja) after editing a recipe,
# then commit the result
add_executable(gr4-recipe-gen tools/gr4-recipe-gen.cpp)
target_link_libraries(gr4-recipe-gen PRIVATE gnuradio-core)

if(ENABLE_TESTING)
  add_subdirectory(test)
endif()
